result.quote: So there was a great famine in Samaria. Indeed, they besieged the city so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver
result.reason: The key is supported, but the prolonged siege is also an explicit, materially different reason for the high price. The present-tense wording also sounds like a general claim; asking why the head “sold for eighty shekels in Samaria” would better specify the historical event.
